name: Journey Planner MVP and Learning Infrastructure
summary: Delivers a constraint-aware Journey Planner MVP with mutually exclusive meal roles, universal free-time choices, clearer round-trip timing and privacy-safe learning infrastructure.
changes: Prevents duplicate breakfast, lunch and dinner choices through semantic roles and exclusivity groups
Adds Fri tid as a valid alternative for every planning block
Allows compatible cross-role replacements such as an evening swim instead of a formal dinner block
Presents major excursions as round-trip containers with departure, arrival, return departure and homecoming times
Keeps anchor activities and explicit choices stable during recomposition
Adds anonymous local learning for selected anchors, replacements and copied plans
Adds an adapter contract for future aggregate learning across visitors without collecting personal data
Uses learned local preference counts as a small ranking signal without inventing social proof
Extends permanent Journey Planner regression coverage
manual_review: Confirm v2026.07.24.240 appears on desktop and mobile
Build a day around Ronda and confirm the anchor remains stable
Replace an evening block and confirm Ronda is retained
Replace a restaurant and confirm only the selected block changes
Check real start/end times and displayed transport estimates
Lock a block and change pace or interest
Use undo and copy the resulting plan
title: Journey Planner MVP and Learning Infrastructure
release_name: Journey Planner MVP and Learning Infrastructure
test: Kontrollér, at BETA-badget viser v2026.07.24.240 på både computer og mobil.
Kontrollér, at en genereret plan aldrig indeholder mere end én morgenmad.
Vælg Ronda, og kontrollér, at afgang, ankomst, hjemkørsel og returtid vises i samme blok.
Udskift en aktivitet med Fri tid, og kontrollér, at resten af planen bevares.
Udskift en middagsblok, og kontrollér, at Pool og pause kan vises som kompatibelt alternativ, når tiden tillader det.
Vælg et alternativ, og kontrollér, at det valgte punkt fastholdes.
Kopiér planen, og kontrollér, at bekræftelsen vises.
Genindlæs siden, foretag flere valg, og kontrollér i browserens udviklerværktøjer, at CasaJourneyLearning.insights() returnerer anonyme tællinger.
Kontrollér, at der ikke vises påstande som “andre har valgt”, før der er en reel fælles datakilde.
Kontrollér, at galleri, forespørgselsflow, navigation og Mission Control fortsat virker.
